items.question: Can AI agents operate autonomously on behalf of New York financial professionals?
items.answer: Agents can operate autonomously for research, synthesis, and information retrieval tasks. For consequential actions (sending communications, executing trades, committing resources), human approval gates are required under ClickMasters' NY financial agent design standards.

items.question: Do FINRA's communication archiving requirements apply to AI agent outputs?
items.answer: Agent-generated communications sent to clients or counterparties by broker-dealer employees must meet FINRA record retention requirements. ClickMasters designs agent output logging to meet FINRA's electronic communications standards for NY broker-dealer clients.

items.question: How does ClickMasters handle attorney-client privilege for NY law firm agents?
items.answer: Privilege-aware access controls ensure agents only retrieve documents authorized for the requesting attorney's matter; on-premises deployment options prevent privileged materials from being transmitted to external LLM providers.

items.question: How long does AI agent development take in New York?
items.answer: 12–24 weeks depending on application type and compliance documentation scope.

items.question: Do we own the agent code after delivery?
items.answer: Yes — full IP transfer at project close. You own all code, models, and documentation.
